tool.title: Every path a declaration names resolves — directories, assets, visualisers, needs
tool.description: Read every instance declaration in the checkout and resolve what it names: `directories` (and those declared from within) through `check:declared-dirs`, `assets` through `check:declared-assets`, `visualisers[].renderedBy` through `check:visualiser-routes`, `needs` through the instance-graph resolver, and `visualisers[].coversKinds` against the graph typologies registered IN THIS CHECKOUT — its own and those a mounted layer contributes, read from the checkout under inspection rather than from where the harness module sits. A declaration that does not parse is a finding. One verdict per instance and field, naming the gate that decided it. Exit 0 every reference resolves, 1 one does not, 2 could not determine; a certain finding is reported before anything undetermined.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: The checkout to check; the script re-runs itself there, so kinds are read from it. Default: the working directory.

outputs.name: findings
outputs.description: Unresolved references per instance and field, and what could not be determined; entries examined per field.
